##Detect invalid parameter
```{r }
Invalid_search_status <- function(){

Invalid_search <- remDr$findElement(using = 'id', 'maincontent' )

cond_A <- Invalid_search$getElementText() == "We have detected an invalid parameter in your search request and are unable to proceed. Please return to the rate review gateway page, update your search, and try again."
cond_B <- str_detect(Invalid_search$getElementText(), "invalid parameter")
cond_C <- str_detect(Invalid_search$getElementText(), "unable")
cond_D <- str_detect(Invalid_search$getElementText(), "update your search")

cond_A | (cond_B & cond_C & cond_D)

}

#Invalid_search_status()
```

##Detect no information available
```{r }

No_info_search_status <- function(){

Invalid_search <- remDr$findElement(using = 'xpath', '//div[@class="compare-no-items article"]' )

cond_A <- Invalid_search$getElementText() == "Based on your entries, no information is available. You may have better results if you make changes to your State and/or Company information and search again."
cond_B <- str_detect(Invalid_search$getElementText(), "no information")
cond_C <- str_detect(Invalid_search$getElementText(), "available")
cond_D <- str_detect(Invalid_search$getElementText(), "search again")

cond_A | (cond_B & cond_C & cond_D)

}

#No_info_search_status()
```

##Data Table Scraping
```{r }
all_data <- list()
cond <- TRUE
```

##Loop Thru Pages for data consolidation
```{r }
append_pages <- function(data_table, val_year, val_state){
    while (cond == TRUE) {
    #Scrap Data Table 
    data_table_html <- data_table$getPageSource()
    page <- read_html(data_table_html %>% unlist())
    df <- html_table(page) %>% .[[1]] %>%
      mutate(Year_Input = val_year,
             State_Input = val_state)
    all_data <<- rbindlist(list(all_data, df))
    
    #Ensure HTML scrap completes
    Sys.sleep(0.2)
    
    #Current page #
    lst_active_button <- remDr$findElement(using = 'xpath', '//a[@class="paginate_active"]' ) 
    lst_page_nbr <-  as.list(strsplit(trimws(lst_active_button$getElementText()), split = '\n')[[1]])
    
    #Next button command and page #
    Next_button <- remDr$findElement(using = 'xpath', '//i[@class="fa fa-angle-right"]' )
    Next_button$clickElement()
    active_button <- remDr$findElement(using = 'xpath', '//a[@class="paginate_active"]' )
    page_nbr <- as.list(strsplit(trimws(active_button$getElementText()), split = '\n')[[1]])
    
    #check if end of pages
    if (compare.list(lst_page_nbr[length(lst_page_nbr)] , page_nbr[length(page_nbr)]) == FALSE) {
        cond <<- TRUE 
        }
      else {
          break
        }
      }
}
```

##function to access product page by index
```{r }
Product_index <- function() {
Products <- remDr$findElements(using = 'xpath', '//div[@class="product-link col-md-12 fixed-bottom"]' )

Product_detail <- function(x) {
Product_detail <- remDr$findElements(using = 'xpath', '//div[@class="product-link col-md-12 fixed-bottom"]' )  %>% unlist() %>% .[[x]]
```

##Download Redacted Memo
```{r }
Download_Memo <- function(val_state, val_year, Carrier_Name, val_product, Product_Name, Carrier_Eff_Dt){
information <- remDr$findElement(using = 'xpath', "//div[@class='redactedMemoLink']/a" ) 
File_Location <- information$getElementAttribute('href') %>% unlist()
File_Extension <- substring(File_Location, regexpr("\\.[^\\.]*$", File_Location)[1], 1000)
Sys.sleep(0.1)
Path <- paste0(General_Path,toString(val_state),"/", toString(val_year),"/",Carrier_Name,"_Eff_",toString(Carrier_Eff_Dt),"_Prod#",val_product,"_",gsub("/","_",Product_Name),File_Extension)
Sys.sleep(0.2)

download.file(url = File_Location, destfile = Path, mode="wb")
Sys.sleep(0.2)
}

#Download_Memo("California","2022")
```

##Create folders
```{r, eval = FALSE}
for (val_state in State_List)
  {
        mainDir <- General_Path
        subDir <- val_state
        if (file.exists(subDir)){
            setwd(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
        } else {
            dir.create(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
            setwd(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
        }
}

for (val_state in State_List)
  {
  for (val_year in Year_List)
    {
          mainDir <- paste0(General_Path,val_state,"/")
          subDir <- val_year
          if (file.exists(subDir)){
              setwd(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
          } else {
              dir.create(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
              setwd(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
          }
  }
}
```

##OUTPUT - Main table consolidation
```{r }
all_data <- list()

for (val_state in State_List)
  {
    for (val_year in Year_List)
      {
       change_button_click() 
       Sys.sleep(0.2)
       search_ACA_button()
       Sys.sleep(0.2)
       year_dropdown_input(val_year)
       Sys.sleep(0.2) 
       state_dropdown_input(val_state)
       Sys.sleep(0.5)
       SG_button_click()
       Sys.sleep(0.5)
       subsearch_button_click()
       Sys.sleep(0.5)
  
       if (No_info_search_status() == FALSE & Invalid_search_status() == FALSE)  {
           Sys.sleep(1)
           data_table <- remDr$findElement(using='id','datatable_wrapper')
           Sys.sleep(1)
           cond <<- TRUE
           append_pages(data_table, val_year, val_state)
           Sys.sleep(0.5)
       }
       Sys.sleep(0.5)
    }
}
```

##OUTPUT - Download Memos
```{r }
subsearch_button_click()
State_List_2 <- State_List
Year_List_2 <- Year_List

for (val_state in State_List_2)
  {
  for (val_year in Year_List_2)
    {
       change_button_click() 
       Sys.sleep(1)
       search_ACA_button()
       Sys.sleep(1)     
       year_dropdown_input(val_year)
       Sys.sleep(1) 
       state_dropdown_input(val_state)
       Sys.sleep(1)
       SG_button_click()
       Sys.sleep(1)
       subsearch_button_click()
       Sys.sleep(1)
  
       if (No_info_search_status() == FALSE & Invalid_search_status() == FALSE)  {
          Sys.sleep(1)
          Carrier_List <- Carrier_showing()
          Sys.sleep(1)
          val_carrier <<- 1
          Sys.sleep(1)
          while (val_carrier <= Carrier_List)
            {
            Sys.sleep(1)
            n <- ifelse(val_carrier %% 10 == 0, 10, val_carrier %% 10)
            Sys.sleep(1)
            Carrier_Name <- carrier_name(n)
            Sys.sleep(1)
            carrier_product_link(n)
            Sys.sleep(1)
            Product_List <- Product_showing()
            Sys.sleep(1)
            Carrier_Eff_Dt <- carrier_eff_dt()
            Sys.sleep(1)
            val_product <<- 1
            Sys.sleep(1)
            while (val_product <= Product_List)
              {
              Sys.sleep(1)
              Product_Name <- Product_detail(val_product)
              Sys.sleep(1)
              Product_click_index(val_product)
              Sys.sleep(1)
              Download_Memo(val_state, val_year, Carrier_Name, val_product, Product_Name, Carrier_Eff_Dt)
              Sys.sleep(1)
              Back_to_Product_List()
              Sys.sleep(1)
              val_product = val_product + 1
              Sys.sleep(1)
              }
            Back_to_Search_Results()
            Sys.sleep(1)
            val_carrier = val_carrier + 1
            Sys.sleep(1)
            Next_button(val_carrier)
            Sys.sleep(1)
            }
            Sys.sleep(1)
       }
       Sys.sleep(1)
    }
}
```

```{r }
transform_vec <- function(vec, n) {
c <- 1
my_matrix <- data.frame(c(NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL), row.names = c("1","2") )
  while (c <= n) {
  my_matrix <- cbind(my_matrix,vec[c])
  c = c + 1
  }
return(my_matrix)
}

Product_detail_v <- function(x) {
Product_detail <- remDr$findElements(using = 'xpath', '//div[@class="rate-change col-md-12"]' ) 
df <- lapply(Product_detail, function (x) x$getElementText()) %>% unlist() 
df <- strsplit(trimws(df), split = '\n') %>% unlist() %>% .[[x]]
return(df)
}
```
